execution_order: Python engine; 3 concurrent independent task/group/repeat cells; parallel candidates within multi-agent group; outputs saved before grading; judge uses a separate model.
seed_policy: Runner seed 42; provider sampling is not deterministic.
cost_basis: API-reported usage multiplied by rates in followup-20261102/experiment.toml; estimated USD, not provider invoice; retry and judge calls included.
latency_basis: Plan generation latency; token/cost fields aggregate all generator and judge calls for the sample.
score_definition: Plan-only quality; JSON contract invalidity scores 0; judge weighted rubric with pass threshold 75 and critical error failure.
limitations: The experiment measured Plan quality only; no task execution success.
The model judge was separate from generators but used the same OpenAI API provider; four pre-run calibration calls checked known good/violating examples, with no human agreement study.
Run-time source was dirty; per-file hashes are in the source manifest.
Pilot has 16 tasks and 3 repeats; paired intervals are exploratory and do not establish universal equivalence.
All recorded costs are usage-based estimates, not provider invoices.
